tools.name: resolve_issuer
tools.description: Find a listed company by ticker, ISIN or LEI: the apex names the owning node and forwards to that node's regional door for the record summary.

tools.name: get_record
tools.description: Return the full Capital Markets Record, served by the owning node's regional door (never stored at the apex).

tools.name: list_events_since
tools.description: Dated, URL'd disclosure events for an issuer since a date, served by the owning node's regional door.

tools.name: list_aliases
tools.description: Sourced trade and former names, served by the owning node's regional door.

tools.name: list_nodes
tools.description: Every market node on the roster (nodes.json, region on each), which are live, their regional doors and Agent Cards.

tools.name: get_signal
tools.description: The ACM-68000 signal for a listed security in its home market: ACM-200 TRADING (on the register), ACM-404 NOT ON THE REGISTER, ACM-451 READ THE FILING (a regulatory filing in the last three days, named), ACM-300 CONDITIONAL (a bare ticker names more than one issuer: add the exchange), ACM-000 NOT AP

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_nodes" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "The twelve market nodes, which are live, their regional doors and Agent Cards." → after: "Every market node on the roster (nodes.json, region on each), which are live, their regional doors and Agent Cards."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
